'''Parvux''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked on the [[Death Mark laser]] project on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Lord [[Nefarid]] attacked the project, Parvux was saved by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]. Parvux helped Din and his [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] temporarily disable the weapon, and Din escorted him to safety.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Parvux worked on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Death Mark laser]] project during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Based on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the satellite [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was designed to end the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] quickly and with minimal loss of life.<ref name="TOR" />

However, the project was attacked in [[3643 BBY]] by Lord [[Nefarid]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Angral]]. Nefarid's forces overwhelmed the security at [[Mensaav Military Laboratory|Mensaav Laboratory]], but the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] arrived and pushed back the attackers. Nefarid was forced to summon the native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] as reinforcements, and Din barricaded himself and Parvux&mdash;the only member of the project he could save&mdash;in one of the lab's secure chambers.<ref name="TOR" />

When Din's [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] arrived, the pair defeated a Killik ambush and discussed the issue of the Death Mark laser. After informing the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] that the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Aleyna Hark]] was in fact a spy who had the weapon's targeting device, Parvux suggested shutting down several [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] to disable the Death Mark laser temporarily. While the Knight did so, Din escorted the doctor to safety at [[Wardpost Duvaal]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parvux was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Jedi Knight storyline on Alderaan as part of the mission "Siege Mentality". After the player and Orgus Din defeat the [[Killik Praetor]], Parvux tells the player to disable three power generators to stop the Death Mark laser temporarily.<ref name="TOR" />
